newsitem.title: CHINA: Spain's Banco Santander to open Shanghai office.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Banco Santander to open Shanghai office.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander will open a Shanghai representative office next Monday to provide commercial and investment banking services to clients, a bank official said on Wednesday.
Banco Santander already has a representative office in Beijing which opened four years ago, the official said.
The official said the bank wanted to eventually upgrade the representative office to a branch.
At the end of 1996, Shanghai had 46 foreign bank branches and 147 representative offices of foreign financial institutions, according to the official media.
